name: Reopen the blocked artery in time
description: Restore blood flow through the occluded coronary artery quickly enough to save myocardium that is ischaemic but not yet dead.

grade.note: Primary angioplasty reduced death, reinfarction and stroke compared with thrombolysis across 23 randomised trials (Keeley 2003) and is standard care worldwide. What remains is a framework constraint — getting the patient to a catheter laboratory in time — not a scientific one. This is the only L5 on this ground, and it is why people survive infarcts and then live with heart failure.
grade.drift: 'Heart attacks are treatable' — the patient is saved; the muscle is not.
